card.name: Linking words before CDK4/6 inhibitor names
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words (with, including, receiving) right before a CDK4/6 inhibitor name such as palbociclib, abemaciclib or ribociclib, in combination-therapy text for breast cancer drugs.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after one CDK4/6 inhibitor name, just before the next one in the list.

modes.label: Link into combination
modes.description: A word such as with, including or receiving that leads into the name of a partner CDK4/6 inhibitor or the drug it is combined with.
modes.example: When fulvestrant injection is used in combination<< with>> abemaciclib, the recommended dose

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting the start of a drug name, such as a word beginning with tam or lim.
card.plain: It lights up on the comma or word just before the next CDK4/6 inhibitor name in a combination-therapy sentence.
